limits: No false path is added for the synchronous reset.

This profile reuses original technology mapping and the v4 clock tree/rerouted checkpoint, then executes a second standard post-GRT repair pass before fresh detailed routing/extraction/stream-out. No fresh synthesis, placement or CTS is claimed. The checkpoint belongs to the unchanged original GUI job. Final timing and electrical constraints are unchanged.

The v2 actual clock tree retained four internal clock trunks with 16 loads against the unchanged fanout limit 10. Version 3 adds the standard CTS buffer spacing of 50 micrometres; success is determined by the actual new reports, never inferred from this parameter.

Version 4 explicitly optimizes and checks intermediate routing at max_ss_100C_1v60 with 30 percent slew/capacitance repair margins. A separate PnR-only SDC uses fanout 8 to reserve antenna-diode headroom. Final signoff retains the original SDC, fanout 10, 0.75 ns slew, original cell capacitance limits and all nine STA corners. Intermediate estimates never establish extracted closure.

Version 4 retained 81 estimated max_ss slew violations after its first repair/reroute pass. Version 5 resumes that exact checkpoint at OpenROAD.RepairDesignPostGRT, including its antenna diodes, so standard repair_design sees the updated routes and loads. The cancelled v4 trial is retained and is not treated as adopted evidence. Success still requires new extracted nine-corner checks and new DRC/LVS/functional evidence.

This retains slow-corner design repair and all-corner setup/hold repair. Upstream scripts are unchanged; the small launcher is frozen per run.
